mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the prediction is associated with a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to higher discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the preceding month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during confirmed tightening episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment claims (PAYEMS) followed by a subsequent decline signals a labor market softening, which precedes a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above previous month's value then declines in the following month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during such labor cycle transitions.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) accompanied by a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates shifting demand-supply dynamics that drive a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST up while INDPRO down in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in such structural shifts.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) over three consecutive months predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days due to reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >70% of such contraction episodes (rolling IC > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 237 for two consecutive months indicates disinflation and is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during confirmed disinflation phases.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.5% triggers a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as investor confidence weakens.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% in the preceding month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative during such regimes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising retail sales (implied via GDPC1) and a decline in manufacturing (RSAFS) suggest shifting demand patterns that predict a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up while RSAFS down in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) in such demand shifts.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS is above 4% and UNRATE is below 5%, the S&P 500 20-day forward return is positive due to a favorable policy-labor composite signal.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >80% of such regime occurrences (IC < 0.1).
